$comment: GENERATED by tools/invariants.py --write. The control for every visual experiment: what must not move while something else does. `kind` is exact / ceiling / floor. Changing a value here is the deliberate act — do it in a commit that says why.

routes.count.why: A visual change must not add or remove a page. If this moves during a restyle, something is generating pages from a stylesheet, which is a different kind of bug.

routes.hash.why: A visual change must not move a URL. Every inbound link, every social card and every sitemap entry depends on this set being stable.

shell.count.why: One function emits <html>. A second is how a masthead comes to exist twice and diverges within a month.

css.stylesheets.why: One stylesheet. Two is how a design system forks.

css.font_families.why: Three: a display serif, a system sans, a mono.

css.webfonts.why: Zero. A webfont is a third-party origin, a render delay and a hole in default-src 'none'. 2036 does not require a new typeface.

css.font_sizes.why: A ceiling, not a target. The sibling repository measures 418; that is what happens without a line.

css.font_weights.why: Four is enough for an editorial system.

css.breakpoints.why: Six. Every one is a layout somebody has to test in Chromium at two viewports.

css.shadows.why: Two: a rest state and a lifted one.

css.gold.why: Zero. Gold says luxury, premium, wealth; this product has to say Europe, discovery, movement, intelligence.

js.applications.why: Five. An application fetches an index or owns client state and must declare its dependencies.

js.enhancements.why: Scripts that do neither and work on markup already in the page.

safety.inline_styles.why: Zero. One style attribute forces style-src open on every page, and CSP hashes do not apply to them.

safety.inline_style_blocks.why: Zero. A page may not ship its own CSS.

safety.img_tags.why: Zero today, because zero photographs are licensed. This moving is the signal that licensed imagery arrived — which must go through the licence register first.

plates.motifs_declared.why: Seven declared. See docs/design-migration.md: one of them is currently unreachable, which this number is what made countable.

primitives.reach.why: The share of pages each primitive appears on. A family that stops using `row` has grown its own components and the design system has forked without anybody deciding.
